content.comment_body: Hello, regarding the newest [product_name] version [version_no], is it possible to upgrade modules from 8.x to version 8.3? Regards [user_name]

This question can't be answered in the forum; only [company_name] can provide a definitive response. Since [product_name] 8.3 hasn’t been released or made available for purchase, it’s unlikely official information is available. My understanding is that firmware updates from 8.1 or 8.2 to 8.3 won’t be possible; upgrading to 8.2 from 8.1 wasn’t supported either. Firmware updates likely only occur within the same series.
I hope [product_name] Web Editor 2.0 can work with [product_name] 8.1 and 8.2 as well, to enable improved functionalities and visual options using the latest web editor version.
I don’t believe [product_name] Web Editor 2.0 will work with [product_name] 8.1. That version doesn’t have the advanced web server, which is present only in 8.2.

Hi, there’s no hardware upgrade path from 8.x to 8.3; it’s a new hardware version. The new 8.3 modules are compatible with existing I/O modules. [product_name] Web Editor version 1.1 will support both 8.2 and 8.3 devices. [product_name] Soft Comfort version 8.3 will maintain backward compatibility, and upgrading older versions of [product_name] Soft Comfort to 8.3 will be possible once available. Hope this clarifies things!
Yes, the new [product_name] Web Editor v1.1 will work with [product_name] 8.2, but the cloud feature in Web Editor v1.1 isn’t available for use with [product_name] 8.2.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members seek clarification on whether existing 8.x hardware for [product_name] modules can be upgraded to the upcoming 8.3 version. There is uncertainty about compatibility of the latest software tools—like [product_name] Web Editor—with prior hardware; especially regarding advanced features such as extended web server support and cloud functionality. Hardware and firmware upgrade limitations generate mixed opinions and concerns about access to improvements when restricted by hardware revision.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to upgrade their existing hardware to the newest versions in order to access improved features and enhancements, and desire continued compatibility with the latest software tools such as [product_name] Web Editor 2.0.
